name: content-engine
description: LinkedIn content engine for B2B founders and their clients. From a person LinkedIn + company site: build a machine-readable LinkedIn strategy in Notion (ICP, voice profile, pillars), audit the profile, run a weekly research+recommendation loop, then creative-first voice-true production. Tracking closes the loop in step 09 — metrics land in the Posts DB and calibrated weights go back into the client strategy. Outputs to Notion in Ukrainian.

linkedin_li_at.title: LinkedIn li_at cookie
linkedin_li_at.description: LinkedIn session cookie (li_at). Optional and NOT required by any step — research uses no-cookie actors, 08-engage works off the live browser session (Sales Navigator search plus notifications) or no-cookie Apify actors. Only set it if you deliberately want cookie-based Apify actors for bulk Sales Navigator exports. Creator analytics with impressions never comes from a cookie or an API — 09-track reads the AggregateAnalytics export the author downloads by hand.
